details.description: Grok 4.7 is SpaceXAI's model for coding and knowledge work, released September 21, 2026 as an update to Grok 4.6. It accepts text and image input with text-only output over a 500K-token context window, and supports four reasoning-effort levels (low, medium, high, xhigh; high by default). xAI's launch post describes improvements on longer, multi-hour agentic tasks, self-checking on complex problems, and resistance to refusals and jailbreak attempts.
advantages: Scores 46 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, ranking #21 of 211 models tracked (Artificial Analysis).
Scores 71.0% on DeepSWE v1.1 and 64.0% on EEBench, an electrical-engineering benchmark (xAI's Grok 4.7 launch post).
xAI reports that only 3.3% of risky prompts were allowed through on HackerBench v0.3, its jailbreak-resistance benchmark.
Supports four reasoning-effort levels (low, medium, high, xhigh; high by default), function calling, and structured outputs (xAI docs).
disadvantages: Scores 19.6% on the Harvey Legal Agent Benchmark and 37.6% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, notably lower than its coding-focused benchmark scores (xAI's Grok 4.7 launch post).
Accepts text and image input only, with text-only output; no audio input/output or native image generation.
Batch API is not supported (xAI docs).
use_cases: Coding and long-running agentic software-engineering tasks
Multi-hour autonomous agent workflows requiring self-verification
General knowledge work with tool use via function calling

sources.title: Grok 4.7 (xhigh) Intelligence, Performance & Price Analysis | Artificial Analysis

notes: Both docs.x.ai and x.ai/news now identify the company as 'SpaceXAI' in page titles and footers (e.g. the grok-4.7 launch post's title tag is 'Introducing Grok 4.7 | SpaceXAI' and grok-4.6's footer reads '(c) 2026 SpaceXAI LLC'), so that name was used as maker instead of 'xAI'. The launch post also reports an AA-Briefcase v1.1 score of 1,657 and a LatchBio biosafety score of 62.4%; both were left out of evaluations because their scale and higher-is-better direction could not be confirmed from the page. No max-output-tokens value distinct from the 500K context window is given on xAI's docs, matching the catalog's facts. Artificial Analysis (accessed 2026-09-24) shows no deprecated label for Grok 4.7, unlike Grok 4.3 and Grok 4.5.
